name: SolveBezierSegment
evidence: bisects 16 times for the parameter of a cubic Bezier whose x matches the given time, then evaluates the segment's value (outF) and its slope (outI)

name: EvaluateHermiteSegment
evidence: from t/duration evaluates the cubic Hermite basis for a value (p0), its first derivative (p1) and second derivative (p2), using end values, the two tangents scaled by the duration and a scale factor

name: EvaluateHermiteVectorSegment
evidence: original assembly: the cubic Hermite basis of t/duration applied to two 16-byte end points and two tangents (vmula/vmadda), writing the point and, when asked, its derivative; EvaluateVectorKeyCurve, SampleCurvePoints and ApplyPoseSourcePosition call it

name: BlendRotationsWithSpin
evidence: cubic blend of two rotations with angular velocities over a duration: builds the rotation from axis-angle terms in u and 1-u, and the blended spin from the relative axis-angle and both input spins

name: SampleCurvePoints
evidence: calls func_00130540 count times for evenly spaced parameters from start to end, writing 16-byte points; DrawProjectedCurve and func_00130C20 use it

name: MeasureCurveSegmentLength
evidence: samples 20 points of a segment with SampleCurvePoints and returns the total of their lengths through AccumulateSegmentLengths (GetSplineLengthAtTime and FillSplinePathLengths call it)

name: FindEarliestTimeWithinCurveLimits
evidence: variadic: for each of n curves takes four coefficients and a double limit, forms four quadratics in them (4, 6, -2, -6 multipliers, at plus and minus the limit), keeps their root pairs as ordered windows and writes the smallest time from 0 that lies in no window; the 0x1549C8 mover calls it with three curves and 1500.0
